mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_bbsinfo WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND bbsinfo_nm LIKE '%' || #{filterKeyword} || '%'

SELECT bbsinfo_id::TEXT AS row_id, bbsinfo_nm, bbsinfo_cd, bbsinfo_desc, list_cnt, file_yn, file_cnt, file_size, notice_yn, new_cnt, use_yn FROM t_bbsinfo WHERE bbsinfo_id = #{rowId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT bbsinfo_id::TEXT AS row_id, bbsinfo_nm FROM t_bbsinfo WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY bbsinfo_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_bbsinfo (bbsinfo_nm, bbsinfo_cd, bbsinfo_desc, list_cnt, file_yn, file_cnt, file_size, notice_yn, new_cnt, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{bbsinfoNm}, #{bbsinfoCd}, #{bbsinfoDesc}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{listCnt}, '')::integer, 10), COALESCE(#{fileYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{fileCnt}, '')::integer, 5), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{fileSize}, '')::integer, 10), COALESCE(#{noticeYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{newCnt}, '')::integer, 0), 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_bbsinfo SET bbsinfo_nm = #{bbsinfoNm}, bbsinfo_cd = #{bbsinfoCd}, bbsinfo_desc = #{bbsinfoDesc}, list_cnt = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{listCnt}, '')::integer, 10), file_yn = COALESCE(#{fileYn}, 'N'), file_cnt = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{fileCnt}, '')::integer, 5), file_size = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{fileSize}, '')::integer, 10), notice_yn = COALESCE(#{noticeYn}, 'N'), new_cnt = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{newCnt}, '')::integer, 0), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE bbsinfo_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE t_bbsinfo SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE bbsinfo_id = #{rowId}::integer
